pois.label: 构型选型裁决
pois.detail: 三条候选路线摆上台面:类闪电大椭圆(远火点驻留极区)、圆极轨、静止+倾角混合。招牌账先算临界倾角——地球的 63.4349° 是 J2 一阶理论 (5cos²i−1)=0 的解,与行星无关,火星专属的答案全部藏在高阶场里(J2²、J3、J4)。数值传播火星全带谐场:e=0.60 的火星 Tundra 轨道临界倾角 = 63.379°,不等于地球数,且随偏心率变(e=0.30 时 63.430°)。然而裁决把这条轨道本身裁掉了:两颗 Tundra 只闭北帽(南帽覆盖 8.7%),双帽闭合最少要 3 颗——而 3 颗圆极轨单平面即可 100% 闭合双帽,圆轨道 e≈0 根本没有拱线可漂,临界倾角需求随之消失。定版:3 星 · 圆轨 · **a=20,528 km** · i≈90° · 单平面 120° 相位。注意这个半径不是静止环的 20,428——**挖掘轮 s17 把它抬高了 100 km**:同半径意味着两环轨道物理相交,而两者周期都是 1 火星日,交会几何不但存在还每天精确重演(详见轨道维持卡)。
pois.detail_en: Three candidates on the table: a Molniya-type high-ellipse (apoapsis dwelling over the pole), a circular polar orbit, and an inclined-synchronous hybrid. The signature ledger derives the critical inclination first: Earth's 63.4349 deg is the first-order J2 solution of (5cos^2 i - 1)=0 and is planet-INDEPENDENT - the Mars-specific answer lives entirely in the higher-order field (J2^2, J3, J4). Propagating the full Mars zonal field numerically: the critical inclination of an e=0.60 Mars Tundra orbit is 63.379 deg - not the Earth number, and eccentricity-dependent (63.430 deg at e=0.30). The adjudication then retires that very orbit: two Tundra birds close only the NORTH cap (south cap 8.7% covered), both caps need three satellites minimum - and three circular polar birds in ONE plane close both caps 100%. A circular orbit has no line of apsides to drift, so the critical-inclination requirement dissolves. Final: 3 sats, circular, **a = 20,528 km**, i ~ 90 deg, single plane, 120 deg phasing. That radius is deliberately NOT the areo ring's 20,428 - the s17 deep-dive raised it by 100 km: equal radii put the two rings on intersecting orbits, and with both periods equal to one sol the encounter geometry repeats exactly every day rather than averaging out (see the orbit-maintenance card).

specs.周期: 24h 48m(比火星恒星日长 10.8 min → 相对地面缓慢西漂 2.65°/sol,极帽对经度全盲)

specs.裁决: 2 颗只闭北帽;双帽最少 3 颗 → 圆轨胜出

pois.physics: 临界倾角的物理:J2 扁率势使拱线以 ∝(5cos²i−1) 的速率进动,63.43° 是它的普适零点——这个一阶解不含 J2 本身,所以任何行星都一样。行星个性从二阶进来:J2² 的耦合项与 J4、J3 的直接项各带 (R/p)² 因子,火星 J2 是地球的 1.8 倍、J4 是 9.5 倍,把零点往下推了 0.056°。偏心率依赖是二阶解的正身证明:一阶解与 e 无关。
pois.physics_en: The physics of the critical inclination: the J2 oblateness potential precesses the line of apsides at a rate proportional to (5cos^2 i - 1), and 63.43 deg is its universal zero - the first-order solution does not contain J2 itself, hence identical for every planet. Planetary identity enters at second order: J2^2 coupling terms plus direct J3/J4 terms, each carrying (R/p)^2 factors. Mars's J2 is 1.8x Earth's and its J4 is 9.5x, pushing the zero down by 0.056 deg. The eccentricity dependence is the fingerprint of a genuine second-order result - the first-order zero is e-independent.
sim: s01(scipy DOP853 全带谐传播,已知答案闸 3 道全绿):地球闪电轨道 J2-only 复现 63.4253°(理论 63.4349,差值即 J2² 自耦合);火星 J2-only 复现 63.4307°(证明偏移是高阶物理不是数值误差);轴对称场下 Lz 守恒 6×10⁻¹⁰

s02 覆盖裁决(与静止环同口径 10° 仰角):tundra2N 北帽 100%/南帽 8.7%(最坏空窗 11.25 h);circ2 双帽 74.8%(空窗 4.1 h);circ3 双帽 100% 零空窗;i=63.4° 圆轨端点也闭合(仿真),且可见弧长对 i 单调递增(解析:180°−2·arcsin(sin19.4°/sin i))→ 64°–90° 全域闭合;取 90° 为南北对称 + 升交点零漂
sim_en: s01 (scipy DOP853 full-zonal propagation, 3 known-answer gates green): Earth Molniya J2-only reproduces 63.4253 deg (theory 63.4349; the gap IS the J2^2 self-coupling); Mars J2-only reproduces 63.4307 (proving the shift is higher-order physics, not numerics); Lz conserved to 6e-10 under the axisymmetric field

s02 coverage adjudication (same 10-deg mask as the areo ring): tundra2N north cap 100% / south cap 8.7% (worst gap 11.25 h); circ2 both caps 74.8% (gaps 4.1 h); circ3 both caps 100%, zero gaps; the i=63.4 circular endpoint ALSO closes (simulated), and the visibility arc grows monotonically with i (analytic: 180-2 asin(sin19.4/sin i)) -> closed across all of 64-90 deg; 90 chosen for N-S symmetry plus zero nodal drift

pois.label: 极帽覆盖与用户链路
pois.detail: Ø3 m Ka/X 双轴用户天线。静止环的用户永远悬在同一个方向,极轨星的用户却从脚下滑过——所以这面碗装在双轴万向架上追人。覆盖账:双极帽(|纬度|≥71°)全天 100%,71° 盲区边界上保证仰角 19.2°,极点 21.1°;顺带把 ≥45° 纬度全境都保到 ≥10° 仰角。链路几何的共构红利:圆轨半径与静止环只差 100 km(s17 的交会隔离抬升),到极帽边缘的最大斜距 19,671 km 对静止环覆盖边缘的 19,565 km——差 0.04 dB,用户链路预算照旧原样继承 com-relay-01,天线、行波管、速率档一个都不用重开账。
pois.detail_en: A 3 m two-axis Ka/X user dish. An areostationary bird's users hang forever in one direction; a polar bird's users slide past beneath it - hence the gimbal that chases them. The coverage ledger: both polar caps (|lat| >= 71 deg) covered 100% of the sol, with 19.2 deg guaranteed elevation at the 71-deg blind-zone edge and 21.1 deg at the pole; as a bonus the whole >=45 deg latitude band gets >=10 deg elevation. The commonality dividend of the geometry: the orbit radius sits within 100 km of the areo ring (the s17 conjunction-separation raise), so the max slant range to the cap edge is 19,671 km against the ring's 19,565 km coverage-edge slant - 0.04 dB apart, and the user link budget is still inherited from com-relay-01 unchanged: same dish, same TWTA, same rate ladder.

specs.最大斜距: 19,664 km ≈ 静止环边缘 19,565 km(+100 km 抬升后,链路差 0.04 dB;s18 闭式解上闸)
specs.单跳时延: 57.1–65.6 ms(天底–帽缘,s18 闭式解上闸)
specs.用户端新增要求(s16): Ka 多普勒 ±25.3 kHz(变化率 2.2 Hz/s)· 每 sol 3 次过顶 · 过顶 9.66 h
specs.链路预算: 原样继承 com-relay-01 用户链(同距离同口径)
specs.「100%」是哪一项(倒问自查后补): **几何可见,不是服务可用度**。先例自己给的分解是「可用度 = 几何可见(星座保证)× 链路(仰角)× 调度争用」——本卡的 100% 只是第一项。第二项在本设计里小:尘对 Ka 近乎透明(µm 尘粒 ≪ λ=9.4 mm,深瑞利区,<0.1 dB,先例已复核并自我更正过「尘暴敏感」的措辞),低仰角的代价只是斜距,已在链路预算内。**第三项本册未算**:每星只有一副可动 Ka 碟(单址,一次跟一个高速用户),极帽同时出现多个高速用户时要排队

specs_en.Guaranteed elevation: 19.2 deg at lat 71, 21.1 deg at the pole
specs_en.Max slant range: 19,664 km ~ areo-ring edge 19,565 km (after the 100 km raise; 0.04 dB of link; gated in s18)
specs_en.One-hop latency: 57.1-65.6 ms (nadir to cap edge; gated in s18 against the closed form)
specs_en.New user-terminal requirement (s16): Ka Doppler +/-25.3 kHz (rate 2.2 Hz/s); 3 passes per sol; 9.66 h per pass
specs_en.Link budget: inherited from com-relay-01 user link as-is (same range, same dish)
specs_en.What the \"100%\" actually is (added aft: GEOMETRIC VISIBILITY, not service availability. The precedent states the decomposition itself: availability = geometric visibility (guaranteed by the constellation) x link (elevation) x scheduling contention. This card's 100% is only the first term. The second is small here - dust is nearly transparent to Ka (um grains << 9.4 mm, deep Rayleigh, <0.1 dB; the precedent checked this and corrected its own "dust-sensitive" wording), and low elevation costs only slant range, already in the budget. The third is NOT computed by this ledger: one steerable Ka dish per bird is single-access, so simultaneous high-rate cap users queue.

pois.physics: 覆盖几何:半径 r 的星对 10° 仰角用户的可见圆半径 λmax = arccos((R/r)cos10°)−10° = 70.6°。极点要看见本星座的星,星下点纬度需 ≥19.4°;一颗星每圈有 141° 的相位段满足——120° 间隔 3 星首尾相接,2 星 180° 间隔留 39° 缺口。这就是「为什么是 3 颗」的全部几何:141° 与 120° 之差是 21° 相位裕度,还顺带吞掉了轨道摄动。
pois.physics_en: Coverage geometry: a satellite at radius r sees users above 10 deg elevation within a visibility circle of lambda_max = arccos((R/r)cos10) - 10 = 70.6 deg. For the pole to see a bird of this ring, the sub-satellite latitude must exceed 19.4 deg; each bird satisfies that over a 141-deg phase arc per orbit - three birds 120 deg apart chain seamlessly, two birds 180 deg apart leave 39-deg holes. That IS the whole geometry of 'why three': the 141-vs-120 margin of 21 deg also swallows orbit perturbation drift for free.
sim: s02 已知答案闸:静止环 ±71°@10° 复现(单星覆盖边 70.6°);极点可见门限仿真 19.45° vs 解析 19.42°
s02 网格账:双帽 2°×10° 网格 × 30 s 步长全火星日扫描,最坏格点覆盖率 = 1.000;时延由斜距/c 直接给出
s16 运营层(挖掘轮):极点每 sol 3 次过顶、每次 9.66 h(对解析 9.65 闸合)、双星重叠 17.6% → 切换是 make-before-break 不是硬断;用户端要跟踪 ±25 kHz 多普勒——静止环用户从来没有这项要求,是本环引入的新终端指标
倒问自查(把「双帽 100%」拆成前提逐条问)找出的第三层沉默:本册从未意识到「覆盖 = 可用」是一个假设。补记设计侧的回答——**多用户并发本就由 UHF 那条路承担**(四臂螺旋、低增益宽波束、天然多址,见 uhf 卡),Ka 单址服务的是少数高速用户;架构本身给了答案,缺的只是把这句写出来。调度争用的定量(先例用 M/G/2 排队 DES 做过)本册未做,列入未做清单

s18(覆盖率普查后补的一本账):把此前**无闸覆盖**的五个交付几何量全部上闸——最大斜距、双端单跳时延、极点保证仰角、静止环接缝纬度、中继 vs 直连时延。**新闸当场抓到两个陈值**:s17 抬升 100 km 后时延边缘 65.3→65.6 ms、斜距 19,671→19,664,卡上都没跟上。⇒ 未上闸的五个量全是"显然"的闭式几何,而**被评审抓出的那个错数(倒置的 68–65 ms)正在这五个里面——「未上闸」和「显然」是同一张名单**
sim_en: s02 known-answer gates: areo ring +/-71 deg @10 deg mask reproduced (single-sat coverage edge 70.6 deg); pole-visibility threshold sim 19.45 vs analytic 19.42 deg
s02 grid ledger: both caps on a 2x10 deg grid at 30 s steps over a full sol - worst-cell coverage = 1.000; latency straight from slant/c

s16 operations layer (deep-dive): 3 passes per sol at the pole, 9.66 h each (gated against the 9.65 h analytic), 17.6% two-bird overlap - handover is make-before-break, not a hard break; the terminal must track +/-25 kHz of Doppler, a requirement an areostationary user never had and this ring introduces

A backward-question audit (decomposing "both caps 100%" into its premises) surfaced a third-layer silence: this ledger never recognised "coverage equals availability" as an assumption at all. The design side already answers it - concurrent multi-user access is carried by the UHF path (quadrifilar helices, low-gain wide beam, inherently multiple-access, see the uhf card) while the single-access Ka dish serves the few high-rate users; the architecture had the answer and only the sentence was missing. The quantitative contention account (the precedent ran an M/G/2 queueing DES for its own) is not done here and is listed as such.

s18 (a ledger added after a coverage census): gates the five delivered geometric quantities that no gate covered - max slant range, one-hop latency at both ends, guaranteed pole elevation, the areo seam latitude, and the relay-versus-direct latency. The new gates immediately caught two stale card values: after the 100 km raise the edge latency moved 65.3 to 65.6 ms and the slant range 19,671 to 19,664, neither of which the card had followed. The five ungated quantities were all "obvious" closed-form geometry - and the one delivered number a reviewer had to catch as wrong, the inverted 68-65 ms latency, was among them. Ungated and obvious were the same list.

pois.label: 与静止环的切换与回程
pois.label_en: Handover & backhaul to the areo ring
pois.detail: Ø2.5 m 金网星间链路天线——与 com-relay-01 对地碟同一件产品,指向从地球换成静止环邻居。极区用户的数据在这里上干线:极轨星 → 静止环 → 对地 X 波段/光链路。切换账挖出一个先例口径的细节:静止环「±71° 连续覆盖」在星下点经度严格成立,但在两星接缝经度(距最近星下点 60°)上,10° 仰角的覆盖边只到纬度 48°,71° 处仰角已是 −0.2°(0° 仰角口径下才回到 70.6°)。本环把 ≥45° 纬度全境保证到 ≥10°,恰好把接缝弱区整个盖住——切换规则因此简单:谁仰角高听谁的,45°–71° 是双系统重叠带。  掩星副产品(本册自算,s19):同一条星间链在每圈两次擦掠大气边缘时,X 波段相位延迟即温压廓线。**敏感度峰在地表附近**——σ_T 0.80±0.04 K(0 km)、1.74±0.09 K(10 km)、3.96±0.20 K(20 km)、9.3±0.5 K(30 km)、25.1±1.3 K(40 km),信息量半高宽 0–4.5 km,σ_T<5 K 的可用带 0–22 km,弯角落到 3σ 噪声的上限 45.5 km(尘暴列 48.3 km,中层增温抬高了那里的折射率,30 km 处 σ_T 反而好到 8.4 K)。**登记变更(2026-09-02,由持有方 sci-thz-01 撤销并改判)**:原先与本产品并列的「20–40 km 交叉验证重叠带」**已被其自行撤销**——其撤销理由是自查出串量(那条 0.43 平均核是**水汽**核,而掩星给的是**温度**,温度在其前向模型里是固定输入,不是与水汽对换的被反演量),且把本册 σ_T 注入其闭环后柱项变化 ≤0.001 pp、低于其蒙卡噪声。改判后按 **0–20 km** 重新登记(其口径、其台账)。**本册的敏感度带不因此改动**:峰仍在地表,可用带仍 0–22 km——变的是对方登记哪一段,不是本产品测得准哪一段。前者是「本链在哪一层测得最准」(本册的账),后者是「本链在哪一层能给 thz 当独立外部校核」(其平均核判据,归其台账)。两者互补而非重复——本产品最有信息的高度在其重叠带之下。模型局限:OWN 参考廓线(210 K 地表、−1.4 K/km 至 45 km 后等温)与 OWN 噪声假设(0.5 mm 路程噪声),**不是预报**;闸门为地球湿大气弯角 0.0226 rad(锚 0.019–0.023)、阿贝尔往返 0.04%、标高恒等式与噪声假设 ×4 的上限位移。**分辨率(s19 G6,此前卡上一个字都没有)**:一条廓线不是点测——垂直是菲涅耳受限的 **845 m**,水平则是**沿射线的平均**:一半的弯角来自切点两侧 ±135 km 之内,**即一条廓线约是 270 km 的水平平均**(1/e 半宽 253 km)。所以「0 km 处 σ_T 0.80 K」读作「约 270 km 尺度上的区域平均温度准到 0.8 K」,不是某一点。对区域平均与单点差别敏感的用户(如 sci-weather-01 的站网比对)须按此口径用。**使用预算(两项分名,勿合并勿只取其一)**:**仪器 σ_T 0.80 K**(0 km,本册 s19,本卡有据)只描述「约 270 km 区域平均」这一件事;若要与单点(如站网)比,还须叠上**代表性误差**——sci-thz-01 用本册 G7 加权反解 σ≈197 km 后判定该项**在 0–10 km 超过仪器项**,并把本产品归类为「受代表性限制的第二 T(z) 源,与 sci-orbiter-01 同级、不更好」。**其数值本卡暂不印**:该值目前只存在于其消息中,尚未落到它自己的卡上,且它正按新的足印口径重折;**卡上数字须有在库锚点**,本册不从回执转抄数字上卡。锚定后本卡补印并注其卡哈希。**结构性结论不依赖该值**:求区域平均用 0.80 K,求单点必须再叠一项且低空以它为主——**0–10 km 既是本产品最准的一段,也是限制它的东西不在本产品的一段。****地形项**:其地形项原按「**1.5 km 起伏 / 425 km 跨度**」线性缩放、身后无测量——**注意其 1.5 km 是起伏值,本册的 1.5 km 是间距,同串数字不同量**;本册曾据此误称其地形项低约 3 倍,**该指控已撤回**(实测差约四分之一,非三倍)。本册在城内 HiRISE Jezero DTM 上实测该跨度起伏 **21.99 m RMS**(s20)——**但 s21 更正了这个数的身份**:该 3.78 km 裁切是整幅 DTM 里**最平的一块**(它是为落区选的)。在原始 DTM(14.4×6.7 km)上取 11 个同尺寸半重叠窗口,同一 1.5 km 跨度的起伏是 **22.03 / 36.89 / 71.81 m**(min/中位/max,**跨窗口差 3.3 倍**);把 s20 那个窗口按投影边界原地取回、原分辨率重算得 25.93 m(重采样平滑可解释)。⇒ **21.99 m 是低侧离群值,不是 Jezero 的代表值;该尺度的中位数是 36.89 m。****并且幂律在足印尺度之前就拐了**:log-log 斜率 4–400 m 为 0.857、≥1 km 降到 0.643,所以把 0.884 外推到 270 km(会给出 2167 pois.detail_en: A 2.5 m gold-mesh inter-satellite dish - the same part as com-relay-01's Earth dish, repointed from Earth to its areostationary neighbors. Polar user data joins the trunk here: polar bird -> areo ring -> X-band/optical downlink. The handover ledger surfaced a subtlety in the precedent's claim: the areo ring's '+/-71 deg continuous coverage' holds exactly at sub-satellite longitudes, but at the seam longitudes (60 deg from the nearest bird) the 10-deg-mask edge sits at latitude 48 deg, and elevation at 71 deg is already -0.2 deg (only a 0-deg mask recovers 70.6). This ring guarantees >=10 deg everywhere above latitude 45 - which happens to blanket the whole seam weakness. The handover rule is therefore simple: take whichever system stands higher in the sky; 45-71 deg is the two-system overlap band.  Occultation by-product (computed by this ledger, s19): the same crosslink grazes the atmosphere twice per orbit, and the X-band phase delay is a temperature-pressure profile. **Sensitivity peaks near the surface** - sigma_T 0.80+/-0.04 K at 0 km, 1.74+/-0.09 K at 10 km, 3.96+/-0.20 K at 20 km, 9.3+/-0.5 K at 30 km, 25.1+/-1.3 K at 40 km; the information half-width is 0-4.5 km, the band with sigma_T under 5 K is 0-22 km, and bending angle reaches 3-sigma noise at 45.5 km (48.3 km in the dust column, where mid-atmosphere warming raises refractivity aloft and sigma_T at 30 km is actually better, 8.4 K). **Registration change (2026-09-02, retracted and re-judged by its holder sci-thz-01)**: the 20-40 km cross-validation overlap band formerly quoted alongside this product has been withdrawn by them. Their stated reason is a crossed quantity - the 0.43 averaging kernel is a WATER VAPOUR kernel while occultation delivers TEMPERATURE, which is a fixed input to their forward model rather than a retrieved quantity trading against water - and injecting this ledger's sigma_T into their closed loop moved the column by at most 0.001 pp, under their own Monte Carlo noise. They have re-registered at 0-20 km, their caliber and their books. **This ledger's sensitivity band does not move**: the peak is still at the surface and the usable band still 0-22 km. What changed is which stretch they register, not where this product measures well. One answers where this link measures best (this ledger's account); the other answers where this link can serve as an independent external check for thz (their averaging-kernel evidence, their books). They are complementary, not duplicates - this product is most informative BELOW the band where it is most useful as a cross-check. Model limits: an OWN reference profile (210 K surface, -1.4 K/km to 45 km then isothermal) and an OWN noise assumption (0.5 mm path-length), so these are not a forecast. Gated on Earth moist bending 0.0226 rad (anchor 0.019-0.023), a 0.04% Abel round trip, a scale-height identity, and a 4x noise-assumption shift of the ceiling.**Resolution (s19 G6; the card previously said nothing at all about this)**: a profile is not a point measurement. Vertically it is Fresnel-limited at 845 m; horizontally it is an AVERAGE along the ray - half the bending comes from within +/-135 km of the tangent point, so one profile is roughly a 270 km horizontal average (1/e half-width 253 km). So "sigma_T 0.80 K at 0 km" reads as "the area-mean temperature over a ~270 km scale is good to 0.8 K", not any single point. Users sensitive to the difference between an area mean and a point - station-network comparisons at sci-weather-01, for one - must use it on those terms.**Use budget - two terms, named separately; do not merge them or take one alone**: the instrument figure **sigma_T 0.80 K** at 0 km (s19, anchored in this ledger) describes only the ~270 km area mean. A comparison against a POINT must add a representativeness term - sci-thz-01 back-solved sigma ~197 km from this ledger's G7 weighting and judged that term to EXCEED the instrument term below about 10 km, classifying this product as a second T(z) source limited by representativeness, on a par with sci-orbiter-01 rather than better. **Its value is deliberately not printed here**: it currently exists only in their message, has not reached their own card, and they are re-folding it under a new footprint caliber. A number on a card needs an in-repository anchor, and this ledger does not copy figures onto cards out of correspondence. It will be printed here, citing their card hash, once anchored. **The structural conclusion does not depend on the value**: use 0.80 K for an area mean; for a point comparison a second term must be added and dominates at low altitude - so 0-10 km is both where this product is most accurate and where what limits it is not this product. **Terrain**: their terrain term was originally a linear scaling of the form "1.5 km of relief over a 425 km span", with no measurement behind it - note that THEIR 1.5 km is a relief value while THIS ledger's 1.5 km is a separation: the same digits, different quantities. This ledger wrongly announced on that basis that their term was low by about threefold; **that accusation is withdrawn** - measured, it is low by roughly a quarter, not a factor of three. this ledger measured that span on the city's HiRISE Jezero DTM at **21.99 m RMS** relief (s20) - **but s21 corrects what that number IS**: the 3.78 km crop is the FLATTEST patch of the DTM, having been chosen for the landing site. Across 11 half-overlapping windows of the same size on the raw 14.4 x 6.7 km DTM, relief at the same 1.5 km separation runs **22.03 / 36.89 / 71.81 m** (min/median/max, a 3.3x spread); relocating s20's exact window by its projection bounds and recomputing at native resolution gives 25.93 m, the difference explained by resampling. So **21.99 m is a low-side outlier, not a Jezero value - the median at that scale is 36.89 m**. And the power law bends well before the footprint scale: the log-log slope is 0.857 over 4-400 m and falls to 0.643 above 1 km, so continuing 0.884 out to 270 km (which would give 2167 m) is quantitatively wrong - the refusal to extrapolate was right and now has a number behind it. The trustworthy range still reaches only 4.1 km, valid pair counts collapsing beyond it, and a real along-track figure still needs global topography, but that map is 3.78 km across - 71x narrower than the 270 km footprint - so it retires an assumption without answering the along-ray question. A real figure needs global topography traversed along the actual ground track; extrapolation is refused, the structure function still climbing at a slope of 0.88 at the edge of the data.**Representativeness values (anchor: sci-thz-01 card `717d2e9`, spec key "footprint representativeness (citable)")**: sigma 197/191/184 km at 0/10/20 km, back-solved from this ledger's G7 quantile half-widths and self-consistent to 4%; **quiet representativeness error 1.89/1.83/1.76 K**, 3.37/3.27/3.15 K at the terminator. **A user of this interface should budget against 1.9 K (surface, quiet) rather than this ledger's sigma_T 0.80 K** - their words. Point-comparison budget is the quadrature sum: **2.05 K** at 0 km, 2.53 at 10, 4.33 at 20, with the **crossover at 10.4 km** - footprint dominating below, instrument above. Their table gives this product its own row under its own footprint caliber, kept separate from sci-orbiter-01's 194 km rather than substituted for it.**Follow-up (2026-09-02)**: they have adopted this ledger's DTM baseline - carrying the median 36.89 m up to their footprint scale with the measured exponent 0.643 puts their terrain term about a quarter higher than their original assumption - and, because the power law is being extrapolated by roughly 1.5 decades, they have replaced their point value with a RANGE, on the same reasoning this ledger used to refuse the extrapolation. **Their revised figures are not printed here yet**: their card is not committed, and an uncommitted working file is not an anchor. The 1.9 K printed above, anchored to 717d2e9, is superseded by its own author; this card will carry the new values with their hash once committed.**Along-track terrain term now measured (s22; MOLA MEGDR 128 px/deg, downloaded with the user's explicit permission, sha256 `14022166...df36`)**. Weighted by this ledger's G7 kernel (sigma 197/191/184 km) along the azimuths the real link geometry produces, over the 0-44N/0-90E tile that contains the city: **total terrain relief 194 / 502 / 1899 m** (min/median/max, a **9.8x spread across locations**) -> 0.27 / 0.70 / 2.66 K. **The decisive move is separating two things**: a footprint sitting on a regional SLOPE - the dichotomy, a basin rim - makes the area mean differ from a point in a way that is known and CORRECTABLE, whereas ROUGHNESS about that slope is not. Tile-wide medians: slope 1.27 m/km, **roughness 393 m (0.55 K)**. **At the city, Jezero: total 1438 m (2.01 K), but most of that is slope (6.83 m/km) and the roughness is only 552 m (0.77 K)** - the city looks like the worst case and its excess is mostly the correctable half. Against sci-thz-01's original 685 m assumption: 0.73x on the tile median, **2.1x on the city total, 0.81x on the city roughness** - so the answer depends on whether the user can correct a known slope, and is not a single number. **Cross-instrument gate**: MOLA reads -2569 m at Jezero, inside the HiRISE DTM's own elevation range, and on the same footprint MOLA's 1.5 km relief is 24.60 m against HiRISE's 33.02 m - 75%, consistent with 463 m sampling. **Limits**: 463 m pixels resolve nothing below about a kilometre; the tile covers only the quadrant containing the city and other tangent points are not evaluated; (this card previously said only six real tangent points fell inside it, forming one cluster - those were TIME SAMPLES of a single pass under slot longitudes this ledger had ASSUMED, corrected by s24 below) so the statistic is measured on a grid using the azimuth distribution the real events produce. **And the power law STEEPENS at large scale** - slope 0.766 over 10-200 km against 0.643 above 1 km on HiRISE - so this ledger's prediction that the bend would continue was wrong: basin-scale structure puts relief back in.**s24 (2026-09-05): the slot longitudes are no longer assumed.** com-relay-01 fixed them at **77.4 / 157.2 / 297.3 E** (city `27bb17d`). This constellation's period, 89,296 s against a sidereal sol of 88,643 s, is a near 1:1 resonance with a **136.6-sol beat** - the same 2.65 deg/sol westward drift already printed on this card - so any per-sol statistic is a thin slice; over a full beat: **753 passes**, of which **12 (1.6%) fall on the Jezero meridian**, revisiting every **~3.5 sol**, sweeping 12-24 N, **closest approach to the city 0.96 km** (converging 3.34, 1.56, 0.96 km as the step halves 20, 10, 5 s). **Blind cross-check against com-relay-01**: this ledger's closest approach to their stated hit at 18.40 N 77.37 E is **1.82 km** (their pre-registered triage threshold 10 km); their solver, read afterwards, computes a DIFFERENT link - the areostationary DTE link to Earth, latitude set by Earth's declination, 172 sols per Mars year - while this ledger's is the polar-areostationary crosslink, latitude swept by the polar bird, about 60 per year in all seasons. **Only the longitude pin is common, and that is what agrees; latitude was pre-registered as not a gate.** The "slot +/-80.4 deg" pin is the equatorial value; at 18-19 N it is 79.86 deg (their 77.37 E implies 79.83), which both solvers already carry. **Terrain by pass population** (54 in the tile): **meridian passes** (within 400 km of the city, 10) total 898/1460/1718 m, **roughness 451/529/594 m**, slope **7 m/km**; loci passes (44) total 226/471/1837 m, roughness 116/379/725 m, slope 1 m/km. So the meridian passes DO sample the city's own air and its terrain: the total is high because the footprint straddles the Isidis/dichotomy ramp, **most of it a known, correctable slope**, with 529 m (0.72 K) of uncorrectable roughness. The earlier single-point city value 1438/552 m sits at this population's median - **it was right; what was wrong was 'the occultations never sample it', true only under the assumed slots**. **Lapse rate now measured**: 0-10 km **1.360 +/- 0.088 K/km (6.3%)**, because both levels come from one hydrostatic integration whose initialisation error is 95% common and cancels in the difference (quadrature would have predicted 12-19%); this card's K columns stay at 1.4, scaling by 0.971 +/- 0.063 under the measured value, inside the location spread already reported. **Seam at 227.25 E**: the polar ring backs it up 60.7% (worst phase) to 78.1% (best) of the sol at the equator, 100% from 45 N (reproducing s02); the areostationary deadband is not in this ledger's model and is com-relay-01's account.

pois.physics: 接缝几何:覆盖边不是纬线而是以星下点为心的球冠圆。单星覆盖半径 70.6°,三星星下点相距 120°,接缝方向离最近星下点 60°——球面勾股 cos70.6° = cos(lat)·cos60° 给出接缝纬度边 48.4°。两个「71」的巧合:星下点经度上 10° 仰角到 71°,接缝经度上 0° 仰角也到 70.6°——先例卡的数字在两种口径下各自成立,只是没写口径。
pois.physics_en: Seam geometry: a coverage edge is not a latitude line but a spherical cap centered on the sub-satellite point. Single-bird radius 70.6 deg, sub-satellite points 120 deg apart, the seam direction 60 deg from the nearest bird - the spherical Pythagoras cos70.6 = cos(lat) x cos60 yields a 48.4-deg seam edge. The coincidence of two '71's: at sub-satellite longitude, the 10-deg mask reaches 71; at seam longitude, a 0-deg mask also reaches 70.6 - the precedent card's number is true under each convention separately; it just never named the convention.

pois.detail: +Z 甲板上的两支四臂螺旋 UHF 天线。极区的用户不是城市,是小站:极冠冰层钻探站、自主探冰车、季节性 CO₂ 霜线监测桩——巴掌大的电台,没有跟踪天线,竖一根鞭状天线就要能上网。UHF 近程链(Electra 体制的火星传统)专为它们而设:400 MHz、低增益宽波束、自适应 8–2048 kbps,过顶即通,由本星汇聚后走 Ka 干线回城。这是「补盲」的另一半含义:不只是让极区被看见,是让极区最小的用户也说得上话。
pois.detail_en: Two quadrifilar-helix UHF antennas on the +Z deck. Polar users are not cities but small stations: cap-ice drilling posts, autonomous ice prospectors, seasonal CO2 frost-line monitoring pylons - palm-sized radios with no tracking dish, needing connectivity from a whip antenna. The UHF proximity link (Mars's Electra tradition) exists exactly for them: 400 MHz, low-gain wide beam, adaptive 8-2048 kbps, connected whenever a bird is overhead, aggregated here and trunked home on Ka. This is the other half of what 'gap-filler' means: not just making the poles visible, but letting the poles' smallest users speak.

pois.physics: 为什么小用户给 UHF 不给 Ka:无跟踪天线的用户只有 0 dBi 全向增益,链路只能靠波长赎回——FSPL ∝ f²,400 MHz 比 32 GHz 低 38 dB,恰好抵掉高增益天线的缺席。代价是带宽窄(几 MHz 谱段),所以这条链永远是 kbps 量级——它不送科学数据洪流,送的是「活着、坐标、要不要人来」。
pois.physics_en: Why small users get UHF, not Ka: a user with no tracking dish has ~0 dBi of omni gain, and the link must be redeemed by wavelength - FSPL scales with f^2, so 400 MHz sits 38 dB below 32 GHz, almost exactly refunding the absent high-gain antenna. The price is bandwidth (a few MHz of spectrum), which is why this link lives forever at kbps - it does not carry the science flood; it carries 'alive, position, send help or not'.

pois.label: 轨道维持
pois.detail:
同周期不同命:静止环的星被 Tharsis 三轴性锁在经度槽位里,最坏槽位年缴 33 m/s;本环虽然同样落在共振周期附近(田谐共振对倾角不豁免,i=90° 下仍有 3.7–7.7 m/s/yr 的绝对漂移力),但极帽覆盖对经度全盲——本环不持有任何经度槽位,唯一要保的是三星 120° 相位,账单只剩相对漂移差 4.7 m/s/yr。升交点在 i=90° 处不进动(dΩ/dt ∝ cos i = 0),太阳第三体的缓慢倾角漂移直接吞下:i 在 64°–90° 间覆盖闭合不变,十五年不用为它点火。

**但这张卡的省钱逻辑自己咬了自己一口(挖掘轮 s17)。**「不控绝对相位」意味着极轨星相对静止环的相位每年扫过 ~980°;而定版首版把两环放在同一半径上(为了链路共构),同半径的两个圆在相交平面里**必然交于两点**,加上两者周期都是 1 火星日——交会几何不平均、不随机,每个火星日精确重演。最近距离塌缩成单参数 ψ(节点经度与相位的组合):d_min = a·ψ/√2,ψ=0 就是撞上,而不控相位的设计保证 ψ 每年扫过零点约 8 次。交会相对速度 √2×1.448 = 2.048 km/s。**裁决:把极环抬高 100 km**(=8× 两环径向游动总和 12.5 km),两条轨道从此不相交,相位自由照旧。代价:链路 0.04 dB、覆盖反而略好、相对地面西漂 2.65°/sol(极帽对经度全盲,不花钱)、相位账 4.45→4.74 m/s/yr(+6.5%,约 2 kg 推进剂)。否掉的替代方案是「连绝对相位一起控」——那要付 7.7 m/s/yr 并把本环好不容易甩掉的槽位需求请回来。15 年 ΔV 116 m/s,推进剂 66 kg,仍是静止环同期最坏槽位的约 1/5。
pois.detail_en:
Same period, different fate: the areo ring's birds are locked into longitude slots by the Tharsis triaxiality, paying up to 33 m/s per year at the worst slot. This ring sits near the same resonance (the tesseral forcing grants no inclination exemption - 3.7-7.7 m/s/yr of absolute drift force remains at i=90), but cap coverage is longitude-blind: the ring holds NO longitude slot, and the only thing to keep is the 120-deg three-bird phasing, so the bill is the differential drift alone, 4.7 m/s/yr. The node does not precess at i=90 (dOmega/dt ~ cos i = 0) and the Sun's slow inclination drift is simply swallowed: coverage stays closed for any i from 64 to 90 deg, so no burns for it in fifteen years.

**But this card's own thrift bit back (deep-dive s17).** Leaving absolute phase uncontrolled means the polar ring's phase relative to the areo ring sweeps ~980 deg per year - and the first delivered version put both rings at the SAME RADIUS for link commonality. Two circles of equal radius in intersecting planes MEET at two points, and with both periods equal to one sol the encounter geometry neither averages out nor randomises: it repeats exactly, every day. The miss distance collapses to a single parameter psi (node longitude combined with phase): d_min = a*psi/sqrt(2), psi = 0 is a collision, and an uncontrolled phase guarantees psi crosses zero about 8 times a year. Closing speed at a perpendicular crossing is sqrt(2) x 1.448 = 2.048 km/s. **Verdict: raise the polar ring by 100 km** (8x the summed radial excursions of 12.5 km) - the orbits can then never intersect and the phase stays free. Cost: 0.04 dB of link, slightly BETTER coverage, a 2.65 deg/sol westward precession the caps are blind to, and a phasing bill of 4.45 -> 4.74 m/s/yr (+6.5%, about 2 kg). The rejected alternative - controlling absolute phase too - would cost 7.7 m/s/yr and reinstate exactly the slot requirement this ring was designed to escape. Over 15 years: 116 m/s, 66 kg of propellant, still about one fifth of the areo ring's worst slot.

pois.physics:
田谐力对倾角的折扣:C22/S22 势对 (2,2,0) 项的倾角函数 ∝ (1+cos i)²,i=90° 时缩到赤道值的 1/4——共振没消失,只是变弱。真正省钱的不是物理是需求:位保费用 = 漂移力 × 你非要待的地方。静止用户的天线钉死在一个方位上,槽位就是产品;极帽用户仰头看的是「头顶有没有星」,经度是自由变量。同一颗行星的同一个引力场,对两种需求开出 5 倍价差。
交会几何的 √2:在节点处两星速度互相垂直、大小同为 v_c,最近点把沿迹偏置对半分,于是 d_min = a·ψ/√2 而不是 a·ψ——分母上的 √2 与相对速度 √2·v_c 是同一个 √2。径向隔离能解决问题的原因也在几何:两个不同半径的同心圆在三维里根本不共点,这正是地球静止轨道共位卫星用偏心率/径向分离保证间距的同一条规则。
pois.physics_en:
The inclination discount on the tesseral force: the (2,2,0) inclination function of the C22/S22 potential scales as (1+cos i)^2, shrinking to a quarter of its equatorial value at i=90 - the resonance does not vanish, it weakens. The real saving is not physics but requirements: station-keeping cost = drift force x the place you insist on staying. An areostationary user's antenna is bolted toward one azimuth, so the slot IS the product; a cap user only needs A bird overhead, and longitude is a free variable. The same gravity field of the same planet bills the two requirements five-fold apart.
The sqrt(2) in the conjunction geometry: at the node the two velocities are perpendicular and equal in magnitude, and the closest approach halves the along-track offset, so d_min = a*psi/sqrt(2) rather than a*psi - the sqrt(2) in the denominator is the same sqrt(2) as in the closing speed sqrt(2)*v_c. Radial separation works for a purely geometric reason too: two concentric circles of different radii share no point in 3-D at all, which is the same rule GEO co-location uses when it separates collocated satellites by eccentricity and radius.

pois.label: 空间天气搭载包
pois.detail: 斜伸出去的悬臂杆尖上那枚金色方块是磁强计,天顶甲板的双筒是能量粒子谱仪——MAVEN 血统的精简搭载包,14 kg / 10 W,干重的 1.1%。开账前先校正一个假设:请求按大椭圆轨道设想「近火点穿电离层」,但裁决定版是 20,528 km 圆轨——没有近火点,原位电离层采样不存在(电离层输入改由星间链路掩星副产品承接,见交接册)。圆轨真正给的采样:全轨道在 6.05 R♂ 高度,晨昏季整圈泡在上游太阳风里,午夜季每圈 29.4% 扫过磁鞘与磁尾,三星 120° 相位保证任意时刻 ≥2 颗在上游——一套常驻的太阳风监视网,顺带每季两次穿越弓激波与磁尾做二点同时采样。SEP 预警的实账,以及本卡初版在这里说错过一次(sci-rad-01 账 6 实证推翻,已改)。**零提前量有两条独立理由,缺一条都读不全**。其一是**空间的**:火星没有地球 L1 那样的上游哨兵,本包与全城同处火星,粒子到它和到城里是同一刻。其二是**能谱的**——2.04 AU 磁力线上 100 MeV 质子 40 min 到、10 MeV 主通量 117 min 到,两者相差 **77 min**——但这 **77 min 是自由空间的谱弥散间隔,不是地表余量**。火星大气截止约 166 MeV,10 MeV 主通量根本不落地;扛地表剂量的是 >166 MeV 硬能带,而到达时间随能量单调变短,所以**最先到的恰恰就是能穿到地面的那批**:地表剂量起始 32.1 min,反而**早于** 77 min 窗口所锚的 100 MeV 前锋(39.5 min)。⇒ **本包对地表剂量的提前量结构性为零**,该窗口**不得用于排 EVA 撤收**。真正给 EVA 提前量的是 com-l4-01 日冕仪那一级(1–3 天 CME 预报);本包对地表留下的是两件别的东西:把地表中子抬升归类为 SEP 的**先验**(见门控链),以及地表拿不到的谱表征(地面只看得见 >166 MeV)。
pois.detail_en: The gold cube on the leaning boom tip is the magnetometer; the twin tubes on the zenith deck are the energetic-particle spectrometer - a MAVEN-heritage slim package, 14 kg / 10 W, 1.1% of dry mass. First, an assumption correction: the request imagined the elliptical option's 'periapsis dipping through the ionosphere', but the adjudicated orbit is circular at 20,528 km - there is no periapsis, and in-situ ionospheric sampling does not exist (ionospheric input is instead served by the crosslink occultation by-product; see the handoff). What the circular orbit actually samples: the whole orbit rides at 6.05 Mars radii - in the dawn-dusk season it soaks in upstream solar wind all the way around, in the noon-midnight season 29.4% of each orbit sweeps the magnetosheath and tail, and the 120-deg phasing keeps >=2 birds upstream at all times: a standing solar-wind monitoring net, with two-point simultaneous bow-shock/tail crossings twice a season for free. The honest SEP-warning ledger, including one thing this card got wrong in its first version (refuted by sci-rad-01's ledger 6, now corrected). Zero lead time has TWO independent reasons and neither alone tells the story. The first is spatial: Mars has no upstream sentinel the way Earth has L1, so this package sits at Mars with the city and the particles reach both at the same instant. The second is spectral - along the 2.04 AU field line 100 MeV protons arrive in 40 min and the 10 MeV main flux in 117 min, 77 minutes apart - but THAT 77 MINUTES IS A FREE-SPACE SPECTRAL-DISPERSION INTERVAL, NOT A SURFACE MARGIN. Mars cuts off around 166 MeV, so the 10 MeV main flux never reaches the ground at all; surface dose is carried by the >166 MeV hard band, and since arrival time falls monotonically with energy, the first particles to arrive anywhere are precisely the ones that penetrate: ground dose begins at 32.1 min, EARLIER than the 39.5 min 100 MeV front the window was keyed to. This package therefore gives structurally ZERO lead time over surface dose, and the interval must NOT be used to schedule EVA recall. Real EVA lead time comes from the com-l4-01 coronagraph tier (1-3 day CME forecasts). What this package does leave the surface is different in kind: the prior that classifies a neutron rise as SEP-driven (see the gating chain), and spectral characterisation the ground cannot obtain, since it sees only >166 MeV.

pois.physics: 速度弥散预警的物理:同一事件的质子沿同一条帕克螺旋线跑,相对论运动学给 β(100 MeV)=0.428、β(10 MeV)=0.145——能谱前锋是闹钟,主通量是洪水,时间差就是撤离窗口。磁强计要上杆的原因:通信母舱的行波管电流与太阳翼回路在星体处造出的杂散场远大于行星际场(~nT 级),磁场测量买的是距离的立方衰减。三个城内用户各取所需:sci-radio-01 拿电离层状态(掩星通道)、sci-rad/EVA 拿事件警报(其对地表的真实提前量见本卡 specs「对地表提前量」行,不是 77 min)、sci-pan-01 与本包按产品分工、不重叠——它是磁谱仪,每个事例都要两端 TOF 符合加 9 层完整径迹才成立(逐事例、慢节奏),出成分与能谱(科学产品);本包是计数率仪器(秒级快节奏),出通量与时序(报警产品)。轨道面也正交:它在赤道面随火星自转、每 sol 扫遍全部地方时,本环扫子午面且恒有 ≥2 颗在弓激波上游,事件期间四点合成赤道/极区 × 上游/下游的采样。
pois.physics_en: The physics of dispersion warning: protons of one event ride the same Parker spiral, and relativistic kinematics gives beta(100 MeV)=0.428 vs beta(10 MeV)=0.145 - the spectral front is the alarm clock, the main flux is the flood, and the gap between them is the evacuation window. Why the magnetometer needs a boom: the TWTA currents and wing loops of a comms bus produce stray fields at the body far exceeding the ~nT interplanetary field; a boom buys cube-law falloff. Three city users, three different products: sci-radio-01 takes ionospheric state (via the occultation channel), sci-rad/EVA takes the event alarm (its true lead over the surface is the specs row above, not 77 minutes), and sci-pan-01 divides the work by product rather than by energy band - it is a magnetic spectrometer that needs a two-end TOF coincidence plus a full nine-layer track for every single event (per-event, slow cadence) and yields composition and spectra (the science product), while this package is a rate meter (second-cadence) yielding flux and timing (the alarm product). The orbit planes are orthogonal too: it rides the equatorial plane and sweeps every local time once per sol as Mars turns beneath it, while this ring sweeps the meridian plane with at least two birds upstream of the bow shock at all times - during an event the four together sample equator/pole against upstream/downstream.

pois.detail: com-relay-01 平台的改型,不是新平台:逐行质量账 90.2% 与静止环中继星同件——同一副 36 m² 太阳翼(同样的星蚀瞬态热容账)、同一个 1.8 m 舱段、同一套 4 mm 铝屏蔽(同高度同辐射环境,Geant4 账直接继承)、同一族反应轮/星敏/推进。改动只有天线甲板与一件搭载:双 3 m 天底碟换成 1×3 m 双轴用户碟 + 1×2.5 m 星间碟(后者本身就是中继星对地碟的同件)+ UHF 螺旋对,外加 14 kg 空间天气搭载包(swx 卡)。单星湿重 1306 kg(含 14 kg 空间天气搭载包,s07;s17 抬升后相位账 +0.3 m/s/yr),三星星座 3.92 t。对 26 个月会合周期备件账的意义:极轨三星与静止环 3+1 共用同一个备件池,不新开任何备件族——一颗备份星能顶两个星座的坑。
pois.detail_en: A variant of the com-relay-01 platform, not a new one: line-by-line, 90.2% of the mass budget is the same part as the areostationary relay - the same 36 m2 solar wing (same eclipse-transient heat-capacity ledger), the same 1.8 m bus section, the same 4 mm Al shielding (same altitude, same radiation environment, Geant4 account inherited), the same reaction-wheel/star-tracker/propulsion families. Only the antenna deck (plus one hosted package) changes: the twin 3 m nadir dishes become one 3 m two-axis user dish plus one 2.5 m crosslink dish (itself the same part as the relay's Earth dish) plus the UHF helix pair, plus the 14 kg space-weather package (see the swx card). 1306 kg wet per bird (incl. the 14 kg space-weather package, s07; +0.3 m/s/yr of phasing after the s17 raise), 3.92 t for the ring of three. What this means for the 26-month synodic spares account: the polar three share ONE spares pool with the areo ring's 3+1 - no new spares family opens, and a single spare bird can fill a hole in either constellation.

pois.physics: 共构不是口号是几何:两个星座半径只差 0.5%(20,528 vs 20,428 km),于是链路距离、辐射剂量深度曲线、热环境、星蚀最长时长全部落在同一张先例账里——平台的每一个子系统都被同一组物理量定尺寸,尺寸相同就是同件。差异被物理压缩到唯一的真差点:用户在哪个方向。这就是为什么改型只动天线甲板。
pois.physics_en: Commonality is not a slogan, it is geometry: the two constellations sit within 0.5% in radius (20,528 vs 20,428 km), so link ranges, the radiation dose-depth curve, the thermal environment and the maximum eclipse length all land on the same precedent ledgers - every subsystem of the platform is sized by the same physical quantities, and same sizing means same part. Physics compresses the difference down to the single real delta: which direction the users are. That is why the variant touches only the antenna deck.
